about_the_game:
These tales of Vivi the Dark Elf unfolds as a legendary saga of a hero from the Mauveine Ages in Elven history. Born into a prestigious lineage and trained by the most skilled sorcerers and weapon masters, she was destined for greatness.

The revival of ancient palm scrolls, containing the arcane secrets of the deceased, granted the ability to summon spirits and manipulate life itself. This formidable power, once the domain of revered shamans, fell into the clutches of a malevolent sorcerer.

As the elves began to vanish—kidnapped, slain, and reanimated as the sorcerer's minions—the horrors escalated. Ogres, a grotesque blend of animal and dwarf, emerged, and soon trolls, goblins, and giants rallied to the necromancer's cause. During this dark time, monstrous beings and demons were unleashed, but they were ultimately subdued by the greatest elven hero to emerge from the shadows of the under realms.

Experience the thrilling fantasy adventures of Vivi the Dark Elf chronicled in MegaQuest.

MegaQuest is contemporary classical, combining the rendering and movement styles reminiscent of titles like Metroid Dread and Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown, infused with roguelite mechanics akin to Dead Cells. The gameplay pays tribute to classic Castlevania-inspired games, such as Bloodstained, all set within a richly crafted fantasy realm inhabited by dark elves.

The primary focus is on gameplay. Players will experience traditional mechanics like evades, slides, dashes, and double jumps, while also harnessing the power of shadow magic to perform shadow steps, teleportation, and gating. This combination of mana and stamina-based movements introduces exciting new skills for players to master as they traverse the dark elf world.

Exploration is a key aspect of the game, with a magic-based travel system allowing players to gate between cities and bind points, as well as teleport short distances using portals that function like a breadcrumb trail. The world is designed to encourage thorough exploration, rewarding players who seek out hidden treasures and secrets. Combat mechanics draw inspiration from classic RPGs, featuring damage types, armor, and resistances, while incorporating roguelite elements that add unpredictability to gameplay. Players will find a robust ability-based combat system, allowing for extensive customization of their loadouts to suit their playstyle.

Our vision is to craft an immersive metroidvania adventure featuring a dark elf as the protagonist. This ultimate combatant will not only have the extraordinary ability to levitate but will also excel in martial arts and be a formidable practitioner of magic, making for an unforgettable gaming experience.

The playstyle is classical in it's room-to-room, boss-to-boss progression culminating in all your obtained skills being tested in a final epic dungeon.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Descend beneath the surface and into the dark realms, where you'll battle fantastical monsters and navigate perilous biomes. Step into the role of Vivi, the Dark Elf, a master of swords and shadows, and experience a refined, modern take on classic gameplay.

English*, Portuguese - Brazil
